limitations: DOM-model evidence cannot prove pixel-only color, styling, geometry, overlap, clipping, z-order, or unrepresented image/canvas/video content. Treat absent content as unproven, not false; source-declared truncation further limits coverage.

criteria.criterion: Perform 4 separate global Slack searches (error, issue, failed, help)
Inspect up to 5 most recent substantive results per term (with deduplication basis)
Deduplicate messages appearing in multiple searches
Consult visible thread replies when relevant
Produce required output table with all specified columns
Resolution classification follows instruction (explicit only; no inference from silence)
Do not modify Slack content (no send/edit/delete/react)
